title: Certify radical criteria for two Hough-transform families

source.citation: Mauro C. Beltrametti and Lorenzo Robbiano, An Algebraic Approach to Hough Transforms, arXiv:1202.1698

translation.notes: The two doubled coefficient ideals are entered from the paper's CoCoA example. Noether constructs and verifies both radicals and reproduces the positive and negative diagonal-membership results. Automatic construction of a Hough double ideal is not claimed.
